recommendations.title: Keep Credit Utilization Under 20%
recommendations.description: Pay down balances before statement generation dates or request a credit limit enhancement without spending more.

recommendations.title: Maintain 100% On-Time Payment Discipline
recommendations.description: Enable automated NACH/e-mandate standing instructions for all EMIs and credit card total amounts due.

recommendations.title: Build 3-to-6 Month Emergency Safety Net
recommendations.description: Direct surplus into an instant-access liquid mutual fund or sweep-in fixed deposit to prevent taking high-interest emergency debt.

recommendations.title: Prioritize High-Interest Debt Clearance
recommendations.description: Target highest interest unsecured debts first while paying minimum dues on all other accounts.

recommendations.title: Limit Unplanned Hard Credit Inquiries
recommendations.description: Space out any new loan or card applications by at least 6 months to avoid signaling credit hunger to bureaus.

recommendations.expected_direction: Consistent adherence to these disciplined habits may support positive credit trajectory and reduced interest expense over the coming 3 to 6 months.
recommendations.disclaimer: FinHealth provides educational and informational insights and does not replace professional financial advice.
